verdict.rationale: v0's docs explicitly describe two-way GitHub sync: connecting a project to a repo, working on isolated branches, previewing changes, running CI, publishing via pull requests, importing existing GitHub code, and resolving CI/merge conflicts — covering bidirectional flow of changes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the GitHub sync workflow specifically (community evidence covers general dev experience, not GitHub sync itself), and no detail on handling upstream repo changes made outside v0.
